title: iPhone free for 5 min while 1 job waits

messages.text:
The iPhone has had no holder for 5 min (since 00:43Z; the lease of iphone-runner ran out). The limit is 5 min.
Waiting on the status board: end-morph (owner fix-end-morph; its wait names the phone).
What unblocks it: the next of fix-end-morph takes it (node tools/lock.mjs acquire iphone --owner <you> ...).
No steward on duty (mgmt-devices is parked): the lead handles this thread (I-175).
One message per idle period; this thread closes by itself when the slot is taken (tools/idle.mjs, I-105).

The iPhone is free on purpose: fix A's last block waits for your unlock step (C-071), not for the phone.
- Cause: the phone locked itself during cooling, so the robot-finger tool (WDA) cannot start. No other job can use a locked phone either.
- Fix now: I pointed fix A's board row at C-071, so this alarm no longer counts it as ready phone work.
- Long-term: fix A's kit checks the robot-finger tool right after every cooling wait (incident I-215).
What you need to do: unlock the iPhone, set Auto-Lock to Never, then press Done on C-071.
